integrity: The proof establishes all integer dimensions q>=4 and real positive shifts; the standalone finite checker independently tests matrix inversion and class-count enumerations and is not a substitute for the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for shifted combinatorial Laplacians on K_2 join an independent set of q>=4, three nonempty colors, independent one-per-color Rademacher forms and variance; no general graph or cost-optimality claim. Publication precedence conditional on wider specialist literature.
title: A sharp proper-to-improper three-probe transition on two-hub split resolvents
